messages:
carl_ae: Heads-up — exec from Baltimore Health pinged me. Pilot traffic shows 200-400ms tail spikes on long prompts and they flagged egress/cost worry. Need a quick unblock: infra + pricing. cc @sarah_sales @mark_se

sarah_sales: Thanks — are they on Hosted trial or a Dedicated eval? Any sample request ids we can share with eng?

carl_ae: Hosted trial, region us-east-2. Sample convo + id:
> user: summarize patient notes (1.2k tokens)
> request id: req-8f7a3b
They ran 3 concurrent heavy calls.

mark_se: Likely a combo of cold KV cache misses + batching. Can you confirm model variant and whether streaming was used?

lee_sre: Already seeing higher CPU on the inference pool during those windows. Cache miss rate ~78% on the pilot worker pool. Looking into autoscaler logs.

katie_pm: Exec also asked for a spend cap — they want an estimate to stay under $5k/mo for pilot. What levers can we propose (token caps, rate limits, dedicated pool sizing)?

ben_csm: I mentioned Dedicated pilot as an option but finance wants the cost delta first. If we can show a scenario (hosted+prewarm vs small Dedicated), they’ll decide. Need ops numbers.

mark_se: Quick mitigations we can try before the call: enable prefix KV prewarm for their common prompts, set continuous batching max latency to 16ms, and offer a quantized fallback variant (gpt-chain-q4) for non-PHI calls.

carl_ae: Can someone produce a one-pager with expected cost delta vs latency gains? Exec needs it before EOD.

lee_sre: Running a quick sim. Pasting recent logs for context: 
```
2026-05-02T14:22:31Z req-8f7a3b latency=412ms tokens=1200 cache_miss=1
2026-05-02T14:22:33Z req-8f7a45 latency=378ms tokens=900 cache_miss=1
```

ops-bot: :warning: Deployment alert — autoscaler scaled 0->3 pods at 14:21:45 UTC. Link: https://console.redwood/ops/alerts/abc123

sarah_sales: I can take the exec call at 16:00 ET if we have numbers. @katie_pm are you free then?

katie_pm: 16:00 ET works. I'll prepare the cost compare slide. Can someone from devex/marketing give a simplified graphic for the exec deck?

ben_csm: I'll own the customer comms and confirm expectations. Also proposing token caps + webhook for fallback notifications if we downshift to quantized variant.

mark_se: Prototype prewarm CLI I’ll run and share: 
```
redwood prewarm --region us-east-2 --model gpt-chain --prompt-set pilot_bh
```

lee_sre: ETA on sim: ~90 minutes. Will post updated p99 and cost lift here.

carl_ae: Exec says: if Dedicated pilot reduces p99 by >30% for comparable cost, they're inclined to sign. Let's aim for clear numbers.

sarah_sales: 👍

katie_pm: Uploaded draft slide here: https://drive.redwood/notes/bh_pilot_costs (private)

lee_sre: Sim results posted in the doc: p99 reduced from ~420ms -> ~120ms with prewarm + tighter batching. Estimated cost delta: hosted w/prewarm +18% vs baseline; small Dedicated pool estimate +5% but with SLA. Will attach raw numbers.

ben_csm: Solid — I'll loop in the customer and book onboarding steps for Dedicated if they greenlight.

carl_ae: Thanks all. I'll run the 16:00 ET call and update exec. Please post any late findings here so I can speak to them.

sarah_sales: On it.

mark_se: One more note — if we need to reduce egress cost quickly, we can set per-route token caps and suggest rate-limited batch windows. I can script the policy.

carl_ae: Closing loop for now. Appreciate the fast turnaround :pray:
